payload.body_you: You want an evening with {{holder1}}, and {{holder1}} wants to stay home alone. Or you want time together and {{holder1}} keeps offering help with errands instead. The problem is not a lack of feeling. The two of you are reaching for different kinds of closeness.
payload.body_they: {{holder1}} wants more time with you than you have to give, or wants a kind of attention you are not offering. You can both care about each other and still end the day disappointed because what {{holder1}} wanted and what you had available were not the same.
